text_block_list.text: One day, with the Hanshin JF right around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Ruck & Buena
text_block_list.text:
—HAAAAAAAH!!
—YAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was amazing...!
For a second today,
I really thought she might run away with the win.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt, that was your best run yet.
You were amazing, Lala-chan!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I felt it too.
The best response I've ever had...!"
choice_data_list: Let's keep this momentum going and win the Hanshin JF!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And let us seize it.
The first glory on the path to becoming a star.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Buena-san?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry.
I just thought it was really wonderful.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Lala-chan and her Trainer.
Because you're looking at the exact same view.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: The same view—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Please do your best in the Hanshin JF.
I'm looking forward to watching you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Buena-san.
I promise I'll reach that level too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: To the stage where Buena-san and the others await.
—The day of the Hanshin JF.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
you seem quite calm today."

Through all her preparation up to today,
Lucky Lilac is fully conditioned to handle
any kind of start to the race.

It is her first GⅠ race, but she shows no fear.
I know she can bloom in full glory...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks to you, I've got just the right amount of nervous energy, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Without pride, yet standing tall and confident...
I'll go show them what our running is made of."
choice_data_list: I'll be dancing while I wait in the winner's circle!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Why couldn't you just wait like a normal person?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you.
Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I'm lookin' forward to workin' with ya today.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Looking as dignified as ever today, Lucky Lilac.
Man, she's definitely going to put on a great run...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Can she follow in Orfe's footsteps and shine?
Today's race is going to be something to see."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"To stay so calm on a GⅠ stage...
She really is incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll burn it into my memory.
Just how strong you are right now...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Today's race is a crucial battle
that will foretell who the future queen will be—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(It's precisely because of a stage like this that I'm definitely gonna win.
I won't give it up to anyone. Today, I'll proclaim it loud and clear!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (I'm the true queen of the Junior Class, see!)
